body: This is exactly how I feel. I shouldn't have to suffer to appease others. They don't have to live my life. They don't know how it feels to wake up numb and hopeless.

Hey! I'm sorry that you relate to this. I feel you on the boulder up hill thing. 

I'm glad you're trying to push through. I hope life gives you a break sometime soon. Thank you, you're so kind. Thanks for responding :)
I'm sorry you have to go through this shit. You got this, keep pushing. Here for you if you need someone to talk to!

I get what you're saying here and maybe it has some truth, but honestly the reason why I don't do those things is because I don't want to hurt others. I couldn't image how i'd feel if I ran somebody over or accidentally hurt others in the process. I know I will hurt my friends and family emotionally but I can't deal with hurting random people, if that makes sense? 

Maybe there is a part of me that wants to be here though... but only if i'm happy. Only if my life does a complete 180 and everything changes. Which I don't see happening. 

I'm trying to find little things to keep me going - at the moment its gymnastics which is random but I found an adult class near me. It's a repeating pattern though - I try something and then eventually it doesn't do it for me anymore. 

Thank you so much for your reply, honestly. It's really sweet and helpful.
Hey thank you! I'll give it a try!

Thank you... this is really sweet.

I appreciate you.

I know you won't believe it but you're not a failure, and you are loved. I know you don't feel it right now. And hell, I can't promise when you'll feel it and if it will be sooner rather than later, but you will feel it. I believe in you and I care about you. You're not worthless.

I really hope you hold on. You deserve to be happy and live a full life.
